verdict.rationale: Orb's docs say several core workflows work in both the UI and the API: subscription creation, subscription edits, and manual invoice issuance via dashboard or API. A full OpenAPI 3.1 spec, SDKs in six languages, and an MCP server exposing 100+ API operations support broad API coverage. However, no source claims complete UI-to-API parity. missing for 10: an explicit parity statement covering all UI features, evidence that plan/price authoring, SQL metric creation and revenue reporting are fully available via API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can create a subscription either from the Orb UI or via the subscription creation API endpoint.
Subscription Edits let you change a single subscription's pricing configuration directly from Orb's web interface or via the API
Remain in draft until manually issued via the dashboard or API
It exposes 100+ Orb API operations as tools, covering customers, subscriptions, plans and prices, billable metrics, invoices, credits, alerts, licenses, event search and price evaluation
